backend: WebGPU required; no silent WebGL fallback
device: One explicitly acquired adapter/device, requested timestamp-query only when supported
sourceAxes: Blender X east, Y north, Z up
runtimeAxes: X east, Y up, Z south; preserved source root rotated -90 degrees around X

quality.toneMapping: Blender OCIO AgX Medium High Contrast,65³ log-input LUT generated from the installed Blender5.1 configuration
quality.geometry: Every evaluated source triangle, exact source vertex/corner normals/UV/color attributes
quality.attributePrecision: Float32, matching evaluated Blender mesh arrays
quality.textures: Original source image bytes, full resolution, sRGB color maps
quality.compression: None; scene binary and HTTP payloads uncompressed
quality.qualityReduction: None; no decimation, LOD, resolution adaptation or distant-object hiding

passes.contributors: All source solid geometry including moving trains; no simplified shadow geometry
passes.coverage: 1120m overview, 190m moving local walking frustum, same fixed shadow texture resolution
passes.update: Once per complete frame, shared by reflection and beauty with identical caster transforms

passes.type: camera-mirrored scene with oblique sea clipping
passes.contributors: Complete source scene including offscreen objects and animated trains, only ocean optical material excluded to prevent feedback
All source geometry; no simplified proxies

passes.ownership: Only indirect diffuse/specular, never direct sunlight; primary camera only

passes.output: Blender OCIO display transform with exactly one final sRGB encoding

lighting.environment: TSL analytic daylight sky, PMREM with solar disc excluded to prevent doubled direct light
lighting.ownership: Direct sun once, sky radiance once, deliberate low hemispheric fill. No baked lightmaps or opaque lighting caches.

water.sourcePreservation: Original full-resolution bathymetry image, source ocean plane/UVs and distant horizon plane, source base colors/roughness/metalness. Static optical ripple normals and scene-reflection translation are declared separately.
water.surface: Distance-filtered static fine optical ripple normals, source roughness and metalness, full-resolution Fresnel scene reflection
water.motion: No environmental wave animation requested; trains alone advance
water.scope: Above-water appearance and surface swimming; underwater volumetric view not implemented

sharing: Global exact geometry/material instances for repeated parts, power-of-two matrix-buffer capacities with exact visible instance counts, static full-detail material groups in 220m cells, and full-detail material merging within each independent carriage, bogie and drawbar root. Positions/normals/UV/color attributes, semantic IDs and triangle ranges are preserved. No BatchedMesh or decimation.

cacheDependencies.source: SHA256 of final blend and binary export
cacheDependencies.geometry: SHA256 of full positions, corner normals, UVs, vertex colors, groups and material slots
cacheDependencies.skyPMREM: Sun direction and atmosphere parameters, fixed for this scene
cacheDependencies.shadows: Refreshed during rendering; no stale cached shadow assumption
cacheDependencies.reflections: Refreshed for every camera and moving-object frame at full framebuffer resolution

navigation.blocking: Principal-axis oriented bounds of connected source components; exact capsule/triangle narrow phase for connected nonconvex rail meshes and graded joists; closed-house footprints; walkable deck/stair meshes support their own treads.

temporal: Wall-clock train animation; controller dt capped at 250ms and subdivided into movements of at most 0.16m. At most one submitted GPU frame in flight, with the same complete render passes. Uncapped frame intervals recorded. Focus loss clears movement keys.
lifecycle: Renderer, geometry/materials, source/color textures, shadow/reflection/contact targets, AO/filter nodes and environment resources are owned and disposed; no automatic retry loop.
runtimeEvidence: runtime_validation.json contains actual final-scene results separately from this chosen configuration

colorTransform.storedOutput: linear-sRGB; browser applies the sRGB encoding once
colorTransform.format: RGBA Float32; R axis varies fastest
colorTransform.gpuStorage: RGBA16F, trilinear filtering; independently measured error in color-transform-validation.json
